criteria.status: verified against the named official GIS feature; independent survey match unavailable
criteria.evidence: Purdue BuildingShapes FID 80, GlobalID {C103E2E9-A417-4A37-BD4E-BD9786DA6F9E}, building name and address match Burton D. Morgan Center / 1201 Mitch Daniels Blvd. The 76 unique source-ring vertices are within 9.54119871e-07 m of saved shell vertices. Shell XY bounds are 25.389 x 58.370 m versus the transformed GIS outline 25.389 x 58.370 m.
criteria.limitation: The shell was constructed from this GIS polygon, so geometric agreement establishes faithful implementation of the source, not independent survey accuracy.

criteria.status: placement and plan dimensions verified relative to the source transform; absolute survey accuracy uncertain
criteria.evidence: Manifest origin matches the GIS outline bounding-box center within 0.000400 m. Asset local dimensions are 25.648 x 61.169 x 8.820 m; the all-object XY extent includes the projecting entrance canopy. Structural shell dimensions follow the GIS perimeter. Orientation retains the feature ring order.
criteria.limitation: Coordinates use the project’s local longitude/latitude-to-meters approximation and no independent geodetic check was available.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The 2004 Purdue dedication article describes a two-story, 31,000-square-foot building; the architect profile supports a flat-roofed contemporary form and a tall entrance glass monitor. The model represents two occupied stories and a flat roof, with 8.82 m monitor top.
criteria.limitation: Official GIS attributes report five levels and extrusion 38 with no verified unit, conflicting with the two-story descriptions. No dimensioned section/elevation was found; wall/roof/monitor heights are estimates.

criteria.status: major forms and materials source-supported; exact details estimated
criteria.evidence: Purdue and architect-attributed photographs show pale metal cladding, glazed bays, red-brick volumes, a glass monitor, and entrance canopy. The architect profile explicitly places brick volumes east and glass/aluminum volumes west; the model includes these elements and orientation.
criteria.limitation: Bay spacing, panel modules, canopy dimensions, and exact facade orientation relative to a surveyed viewpoint are not measured; photos are not georeferenced and the historic photos date to the 2004 opening.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Main asset reopened with 384 objects and 382 meshes; all 384 canonical manifest names resolve, including two preserved as custom properties for Blender's object-name limit. Independent export reopen found 384 objects and 382 meshes with matching names and no unpacked external images. Evidence records provider, URL, FID, retrieval date, CRS, source dates, measurements, and uncertainty.
criteria.limitation: No additional limitation affecting library portability or evidence completeness.

findings: GIS polygon and model shell agree at sub-micrometer tolerance because the shell was generated from that exact feature; no independent survey footprint was found.
The GIS floor-count fields (5) conflict with Purdue and architect descriptions (2 stories); the model follows the narrative sources and leaves exact height unverified.
Facade rhythm, wall heights, roof equipment, canopy dimensions, and interior layout are not supported by dimensioned plans; interior remains schematic.
